method: Derived from the project's own files -- one entry per `.sql` model, per `sources: -> tables:` entry, per `semantic_models:` and per `metrics:` entry. Never from extractor output.
covers: Every kind a run over this tree emits. `data` is not a bundle archetype, so `common.*` runs over the same tree: the four `.sql` files carry no configuration keys, and `dbt_project.yml`, `models/schema.yml` and `models/semantic/semantic_models.yml` are all claimed by this pack through `adopt_map.documents`, which is why no `config_key` appears below. A run that started minting `config_key/yaml/models.0.name` here would be B1-CR-74 regressing, and this set is what would catch it.
unlabeled_note: `unlabeled: true` where the project documents nothing. Two models and one metric -- the ordinary state of a real warehouse, and the same bucket `ZFIELD_003` lands in.

identities.note: no label: -- unlabelled arriving from a third direction
